# Shailesh Chaudhari — Portfolio

> Software Engineer (~2.5 years) with a backend focus. Current role: backend of ContextQA's core QA-automation product (test execution engine, VNC streaming, Playwright/WebdriverIO/LambdaTest orchestration).

Shailesh Chaudhari is a Software Engineer based in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India (originally from Patan, Gujarat). BE in Information Technology from Government Engineering College, Bhavnagar (2024, CGPA 7.99). Institute Rank 1 on GeeksforGeeks with 604+ problems solved.

Professional timeline:
- Jan 2024 – Aug 2024: Software Developer Intern at EsparkBiz Technologies (full-stack learning — Node.js, React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind; dummy projects; real-time patterns).
- Aug 2024 – Jul 2025: Software Engineer at EsparkBiz Technologies (3 client projects end-to-end — full-stack UI, backend APIs, client communication and requirements).
- Jul 2025 – present: Software Engineer at ContextQA. First 2-3 months: shipped 2 Chrome extensions (Vibe Testing for AI-powered web testing, AxeTos for WCAG accessibility). Since then: backend of the core QA-automation product (test execution engine, VNC streaming, browser-automation orchestration via Playwright / WebdriverIO / LambdaTest).

## Side projects (shipped)

Live:

- [EduScale](https://eduscale.vercel.app/): Real-time engineering learning platform with 1v1 coding battles. Backend uses @socket.io/redis-adapter (horizontal Socket.io scaling), redlock (distributed locks on the battle start / submit-answer / complete paths), opossum (circuit breaker around the Judge0 code-execution call), prom-client (Prometheus /metrics: request duration, active connections, memory), and a Bull queue with a dead-letter queue for email. Stack: Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, Node.js, Express, Prisma, PostgreSQL, Redis, Supabase Auth.
- [DevTrack](https://daily-dev-track.vercel.app): Developer productivity dashboard. Supabase Realtime postgres_changes subscription on daily_logs for live activity feed + sub-second multi-tab sync. Stack: Next.js, TypeScript, Prisma, PostgreSQL, Supabase Realtime, Recharts.
- [KhataGO](https://khatago.vercel.app/): WhatsApp-first AI accounting for Indian SMBs. WhatsApp Business webhook with DB-enforced idempotency (unique message id + an atomic PENDING→PROCESSING claim, no cache in the path), Gemini AI function-calling for receipt OCR → structured transactions + receivables management. Stack: Next.js, Gemini AI SDK, WhatsApp Cloud API, PostgreSQL (Prisma), i18n (en/hi/gu).

Open source:

- [CareerGlyph](https://github.com/Shailesh93602/careerglyph): Developer identity platform replacing static resumes. NestJS monorepo backend (58 tests across 5 suites: JWT auth, skills/projects/endorsements with a compound unique key, rate-limited auth). Next.js 14 frontend with public profile viewer at /[username], TanStack Query optimistic endorsements.
- [CodeSenseiSearch](https://github.com/Shailesh93602/CodeSenseiSearch): AI-powered semantic code search. NestJS backend with pgvector, AST-aware function/class-level chunking, Gemini embeddings, cosine-similarity ranking. The retrieval pipeline is scaffolded, not yet wired end to end. Natural-language queries return ranked file+line results.

ContextQA Chrome extensions (shipped in first 2-3 months at ContextQA, 2025):

- Vibe Testing: Chrome extension for AI-powered web testing with real-time log streaming. Stack: Chrome Extension, Python AI Agent, Node.js, Socket.io.
- AxeTos: Chrome extension for WCAG A/AA/AAA accessibility testing with intelligent fix suggestions. Stack: Chrome Extension, Node.js, axe-core, AWS S3.
